features.title: Features
items: Attribute points and a skill point every level; a skill tree of three branches.
96 items in 10 families, worn by slot, with set bonuses at 2, 4 and 6 pieces.
Reheat gear up to +4 at the forge, and set 19 kinds of monster card into it.
Patrols, packs, ambushes, guardians and mimics on the map.
Day and night: at night your sight shrinks and shadows hunt you.
Your fallen champions rise and hunt you; your winners return as Landlords.
Separate bank and purse: stake gold at the start and cash out after each Landlord.
9 optional oaths that raise both the difficulty and the payout.
Voices with emotion for every character, and ambient sound for every biome.
A herbarium, a bestiary and 12 feats in the Journal.
Native 640x360 pixel art with mouse, keyboard, controller and touch.

demo.title: Download the demo
demo.intro: A free demo for Windows, macOS and Linux. It plays the whole run, with fewer champions and relics to choose from.
includes: 2 champions: the Ironbound Penitent and the Gallows Marksman.
The full run: three weeks on the map, events, shops, oaths and the Landlords.
No Reliquary: the other champions, relic families and purse upgrades come with the full game.
Its own save, separate from the full game.
demo.windowsNote: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. One .exe file, no installer. The file is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you: click More info, then Run anyway.
demo.macosNote: One app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Unzip it and drag Dawnbringer to Applications.
demo.macosOpen: The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Right-click (or Control-click) the app and choose Open. If there is no Open button, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
demo.linuxNote: x86_64. Extract the archive and run DawnbringerDemo.x86_64. Needs graphics drivers with OpenGL 3.3.
demo.android: Android: the closed alpha is open.
demo.ios: iPhone and iPad: not available yet.

beta.title: Join the Android alpha
beta.testCardCaption: Annotated Android test payment screenshot. The X crosses out the simulated amount. Green outlines mark the test card and Google's notice: this is a test order, you will not be charged.
beta.paymentNoticeTitle: The test payment amount is NOT REAL. You WILL NOT BE CHARGED.
beta.paymentNoticeText: With Test card, always approves, Google Play only simulates a purchase. Even if R$9.99 or another amount appears, no money is taken. Check that this is the selected payment method. If your personal card or another real payment method appears, do not confirm and contact us.
beta.intro: Play the Android version for free before launch.
beta.step1: Open Dawnbringer Testers and click Join group. Sign in with the Google account you use in the Play Store on Android. Opening the group is not enough: confirm that you have joined.
beta.step2: With that same account, open the test page and click Become a tester. Wait for confirmation that you have joined the test before continuing.
beta.step3: On your Android phone or tablet, open the game on Google Play and tap Install. On a computer, select your Android device in the dialog and click Install.
beta.note: Free alpha access ends at launch. Joining the test does not include a purchase of the final game.
beta.accountHelp: Use the same account for all three steps: the group, the test page, and the Play Store. If you have several Google accounts, check the profile picture on each page and in the store app.
beta.priceTitle: Seeing a price or a Buy button?
beta.priceHelp: The listing can show a price even for a tester. Complete steps 1 and 2 first. On a computer, click Buy to open the device selection dialog. If it offers Install, select your Android device and click that button, as shown below. If a payment screen appears, read the test card instructions before confirming.
beta.storeCaption: On a computer, Google Play may show R$9.99 and Buy even during the test.
beta.installCaption: The next dialog may offer Install. Select your Android device to send the installation.
beta.paymentTitle: What is Test card, always approves?
beta.paymentHelp: It is Google Play's test payment card. If the payment method says Test card, always approves, confirming makes a simulated purchase with no real charge. If you see your own card or another real payment method, do not confirm. Check the account used in all three steps and contact us if the problem continues.
beta.unavailableTitle: Can't find the game or join the test?
beta.unavailableHelp: Check that you joined the group and opted into the test with your Play Store account. Wait a few minutes and reopen the test page. If you still cannot get access, send a screenshot of the message, without payment details, to

press.description: Dawnbringer is a dark-fantasy roguelike auto-battler in pixel art. The sun is dead, gold is the only warmth left, and every week a Landlord comes for the rent. Players cross a turn-based map, pick fights, and build a champion: a second class out of 12, a skill tree, attribute points, and 96 items worn by slot, reheated at the forge and set with monster cards. Combat resolves automatically without dice, and the game never shows how a fight will end: every foe carries visible items, so players judge each fight by reading its gear against their build, and a Stone of Despair only darkens when a fight would kill the hero. Against the Landlord it stays silent, and the player must pay the tithe or fight. Before each run players stake gold from their bank, and after each week they cash out the purse or risk it in a harder week. Fallen champions rise and hunt the player in later runs, while victorious champions can return on a Landlord's throne. Every character speaks with a synthetic voice, and each of the six biomes has its own plants, animals and ambient sound.
